Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap: we covered your two primary goals (reduce inference cost for nightly batch runs; deliver sub-200ms tail latency for the web UI during peak hours). We think a short technical deep-dive with our infra lead would be most valuable next — specifically to review:

- your current model size & batch profiles
- network/topology constraints in your staging VPC
- options for Dedicated vs Private deployment and associated SLAs

I had tentatively put a slot on the calendar for Wednesday but I see some conflicting calendar notes on your side. Can you confirm one of the two compact slots below (we'll keep this strictly 30 minutes):

1) Wed 19 Aug, 10:00–10:30 PDT (team: Karthik + Soojin + Connor)
2) Thu 20 Aug, 09:00–09:30 PDT (same team)

If neither works, please propose one 30m window in the next 5 business days and we'll prioritize it. Attaching the discovery notes and a lean agenda — should help your ops person quickly validate prerequisites.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

—Karthik
